upMob

Source: R/intMob.R
upMob.Rd

Upward Mobility Parameters

Usage

upMob(Y, T, amount = 0, qcutoffs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75))

Arguments

Y

vector of outcomes

T

vector of treatments

amount

How much child's rank has to increase in order to count for upward mobility

qcutoffs

the quantiles where to draw the cutoff points in the transition matrix; default is at the quartiles

Value

vector of amount of upward mobility by parents' income quartile (or other specified cutoffs)

Examples

upMob(nlsy97$lci, nlsy97$lpi)
#> [1] 0.8302583 0.5725191 0.3867596 0.1666667
